notes.title: It's time to climb in Cairn's demo! 🏔️
notes.notes:
Hi there, 

You know how they say good things come to those who wait? Well, thank you for your patience, but wait no more: go and play Cairn's demo right now 🧗

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170150/Cairn_Demo/

In the demo, you play as Aava, attempting your first ascent before heading to mount Kami. After a warm-up in the climbing gym, you climb to the summit of mount Tenzen. You have full freedom to explore the small mountain ridge, learn how to climb, forage, and survive in a low-pressure environment. It packs many of the features of the full game.

To mark the occasion, we premiered a brand new gameplay trailer, check it out:

[previewyoutube=Q4In8-k2A-I;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Introducing Cairn
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

It is finally time for us to let you in on what we've been cooking: our next game Cairn, a mountain ascent adventure with an intuitive climbing simulation. 

Read the whole description here - also see the superstars who have joined our team to make this game! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588550/Cairn/

We have created a new climbing simulation that gives you complete freedom to explore the mountain, read the rock face and decide on your route. Climbing is challenging, with difficult sections to navigate, and you will need to use your equipment and pitons wisely. Cairn’s story mode will take you on Aava’s journey, as she sets to conquer a summit no one has  reached before, and you will decide what she’s ready to sacrifice to achieve the ascent.

[previewyoutube=nhyMWuORSuA;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll share more with you soon, but in the meantime [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588550/Cairn/]wishlist Cairn[/url] and stay tuned by: 
[list]
[*] Joining us on [url=http://discord.gg/thegamebakers]Discord[/url]
[*] Joining our (very occasional) [url=https://bit.ly/NewsletterTGB]newsletter.[/url] 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33507308/6d60c64cf78b1f2fcd7b371b9fdcecf1b1a41ec1.jpg[/img]
After years of secrecy, it feels really good for the whole team to finally be sharing this with you, and we can’t wait to hear your feedback - and show you more!

Until then,
The Game Bakers

notes.title: Furi Demake - The Chain, out now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

We have a gift for you today: we’re launching a new game, inspired by Furi, and it’s entirely free! It’s an 8-bit-inspired version of The Chain’s boss fight, with frantic controls, fast-paced combat and mix of melee and ranged combat. In good old 8-bit pixel art and music from the 90s!

Check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2593450/Furi_Demake__The_Chain/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23727865/8e6b7f2cc0318cf80262284490f17b322f58f922.gif[/img]

To make this game come true, we’re partnered with Sylph, a solo dev specializing in 8-bit games. It’s been a passion project for the past few months, and we wanted to make this Demake completely free to thank you for your amazing support since the launch of Furi. 

Ready to dive into some intense and fast Furi-inspired gameplay with retro controls and style?

[previewyoutube=w9nTiXyKGhQ;full][/previewyoutube]
And to celebrate, we’ll be hosting a week-long community celebration, from now until December 6th. 
This week’s activities will include a dev stream with an all-star cast from the dev team, Furi’s creative director fighting The Strap in Furi, a fan art contest, a Furi Demake speedrun competition, merch discounts, and surprises that will be posted here and on our social media during the week.

That’s not all! Furi and its [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1802170/Furi__Onnamusha/]DLC Onnamusha[/url] are discounted the whole week - let your friends know they can get them at a low price and try out the demake.

Participate and stay posted with our news by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/thegamebakers]Discord[/url] or signing up for our very occasional [url=https://bit.ly/NewsletterTGB]newsletter from The Bakery[/url].

notes.title: Haven will be available on December 3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're pleased to let you know that our new game Haven will be available on December 3. We are also happy to share with you a brand new story trailer "Can love conquer all?" Watch it below:

[previewyoutube=bVmGYPrzOxc;full][/previewyoutube]

In Haven play as a couple in love, Yu and Kay, who have left everything they’ve known to escape to an eerie and unstable planet in hopes to stay together. Play both characters at the same time while exploring an authentic and relatable relationship. Synchronise the combat of both characters while battling to protect their lives and the relationship. Glide together through a mysterious landscape, craft, cook, and gather resources to make a cozy home, repair your ship, fight in real-time, and make the ultimate choice about if it’s worth sacrificing everything for love.

Haven allows players a look into the everyday life of Yu and Kay while inviting players to follow their adventures, relax, laugh, and connect to the characters. While Haven is not without fighting, thrills, and unexpected surprises, it does take you on a journey often not explored in games: one of a true adult relationship. 

We hope that you will ponder nuanced questions about the meaning of love and freedom and if love is worth sacrificing everything for.

We hope you will enjoy it!

The Game Bakers

notes.title: Haven’s opening movie will French kiss your eyes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982976/ce25bb0f39ae55d9d274ce143050116a3ce3870c.png[/img]

Today we are happy to unveil the Opening Movie of Haven, the video which will welcome you every time you start the game.  The opening was created and directed by [url=http://www.studio-shaft.fr/studio/artistes-invites/animation-realisation/yukio-takatsu/]Yukio Takatsu[/url] - a specialist of anime openings, with the support of [url=http://yapiko.fr/?lang=en]Yapiko Animation[/url] and on a music by [url=http://2emedanger.com/]Danger[/url]. 

Takatsu-san did an incredible job bringing our concepts, world and characters to life. The editing really makes Danger's original music created for the game shine, and vice versa. We hope you will want to dance and twirl like Yu and Kay.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bIhi9FP97Ys

The art style is different from the art in the game of course, but in its essence, it's exactly what we are trying to achieve with the game: a couple of characters who love each other, and with whom we hope you are going to fall in love in turn. An established relationship, that's still evolving, in movement, gliding and twirling at a fast pace, tied by flow and rust, across different planets.

notes.title: Surprise! Haven demo available for 48 hours!
notes.notes:
For the occasion of [b]The Game Awards[/b] that take place later today, Valve is launching a [b]"Game Festival"[/b] on Steam: a special event featuring a collection of game demos available for 48 hours. [i]Haven[/i] was invited to be part of it! You can download the demo until Saturday December 14th, don't miss it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982976/4af45005d09690c432ae7cac23146a33b77259bc.jpg[/img]

The demo features the very beginning of the game, to get to know our two lovers stranded on a forgotten planet. But before you start your journey with Yu and Kay, here is some information to keep in mind:
[list]
[*] The demo is beta stage, not final quality
[*] The demo is single-player only (the final game supports local co-op)
[*] A controller is recommended. You can review the controls below. (keyboard and mouse controls are very work in progress). 
[*] English, French and Japanese languages (change in Pause menu).
[/list]

It's the demo some of you already played at PAX West, Tokyo Game Show, Indie X or XO 19 that we are happy to make available for everyone on Steam.

So have fun, and we're looking forward to your feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/thegamebakers]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/thegamebakers?lang=fr]Twitter [/url] or here on Steam.

notes.title: Haven gameplay reveal - Hand in hand gliding over the grass
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982976/3157ace95fed2a5825a73e1d801700be0d8efbd9.png[/img]
Finally we can show you more about Haven! 

There are many special moments during the development of a game but the first time you disclose the gameplay of your game to the public is certainly one of the most exciting ones. 

So check the gameplay trailer here: 
https://youtu.be/ragUUT9bsFQ
And then [url=https://www.thegamebakers.com/hand-in-hand-in-haven/]read a few words from Emeric Thoa[/url] the game creative director about the intentions and influences for Haven, and tell us what you think. 

Emeric will also be holding a [b]Q&A on Discord server Monday July 15th[/b] at 21h CEST - 12h00 PT. You know the way to our Discord to ask your questions!

Last we hope to see you at PAX West where we'll have a demo for you to try,  come and meet us!

- - -

Share the journey of two lovers, escaped to a lost planet in a desperate attempt to stay together. Glide over the grasslands of a shattered planet, unraveling its mysteries to find a way to settle for good.
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]https://i.imgur.com/esFZUwD.gif[/img]

Haven is a story-rich adventure, with touching characters with whom you fall in love as you follow them through their challenges and everyday life. But it’s also a (J)RPG with an innovative combat system that lets you play the two characters at the same time, and chain actions using tactics and timing. 
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]https://i.imgur.com/0tf1PQt.gif[/img]

The colorful and dreamy art direction of the light science fiction world of Haven is coming to life thanks to an original electro soundtrack by Danger, with a range of tracks that will carry players from the energy of a sunny morning to the tension of a fight in the mountains at night.
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]https://i.imgur.com/gJvUoih.gif[/img]

Haven is a solo game at its core, but at any time, a second player can jump in locally. Players can then share a moment of exploration and progression together.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982976/90cd8afeb2a2b3bd4859fdec3a580402fceab318.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982976/7c8a9ebf1bd5b1c72ca1b02affddb469af938b27.png[/img]

notes.title: World domination by cephalopods: Squids Odyssey is on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello,
In order to achieve world domination by cephalopods and because we always thought that the game belonged here, among other sweet RPGs, we're bringing our classic Squids Odyssey to Steam today. 

Different versions of the game have been enjoyed on different platforms by about two million players, but here we are bringing on Steam the [u]deluxe version[/u], with all content ever created and tons of improvements. Plus great controls on PC.

Squids Odyssey follows the adventures of a band of unlikely Squid heroes fighting back to save their underwater kingdom from a murky black ooze. 

The game is a pretty unique tactical RPG, with a great deal of content. Don't overlook the game as a family / kids game only, it offers a real challenge and it can get tough. And there's even a completely redesigned Pro Mode for the more hardcore players.

With more than 90 levels, 3 chapters of the story, 15 heroes to recruit, the new version offers more than 15 hours of play, even without the Pro Mode.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32982976/9206a6544d1adb4b4ddd20c075197135302acc31.jpg[/img]

[u]Key features from Squids Odyssey:[/u]

[list]
[*]A challenging tactical RPG: hero classes, stat-boosting helmets, power-ups and the environment add a strategic element to the role-playing gameplay.
[*]Build your party from 15 Squids in 4 classes: shooters, scouts, troopers, and healers, and boost their abilities with 65+ barmy helmets.
[*]Engage in 90+ missions for more than 15 hours of gameplay
[*]An expert Pro Mode, with completely redesigned missions, doubles the challenge and the game length!
[*]Battle your way through Greek citadels, tropical coral reefs, old West inspired towns and Japanese temples to save your underwater world!
[*]Includes all content previously released in the Squids series with tons of improvement and tweaks.
[*]Languages: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese.
[*]2 million players have enjoyed the game on the different platforms.
